caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug positioned upright in the center of the composition, occupying most of the space within a thin rectangular border. The jug is rendered in shades of beige and light brown with subtle gradations to suggest curvature and volume. It has a rounded belly, a narrower neck, a small pouring spout, and a thick, looped handle that attaches to the body just below the rim and to the shoulder of the jug. The jug is decorated with broad, organic brushstrokes in medium and dark blue around the neck, the upper body, and under the handle, suggesting a simple leaf or feather motif. The interior of the jug is shaded in a darker brownish tone, contrasting with the lighter exterior. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white in color, emphasizing the jug as the central focus of the artwork. A small, unobtrusive artist’s signature and date appear at the bottom left within the border.
title: Batter Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
